subject: HackDay workshop exchange & custom sponsor bundle
messages:
From: Emma Bates <emma@greenfieldlabs.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Greenfield Labs Sponsorships <sponsorships@greenfieldlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sponsorship inquiry — HackDay workshop & tier request

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking a look at Greenfield Labs' participation at DevForward HackDay (March 2027). We're interested in a custom package that includes: a half-day workshop (40–60 pax), a 6x6 demo pod, and prominent logo placement on the hackathon stage backdrop.

Quick constraints from our side:
- We have a hard budget cap and would prefer to trade a speaking slot (30-min panel) for an enhanced workshop promotion in pre-event emails.
- We need confirmation of logo size/position relative to platinum sponsors — our marketing team will only sign off with a minimum 300px height placement on the stage asset.
- Can you confirm whether workshop attendees get discounted access to the main conference sessions?

Attaching a draft sponsor checklist from our procurement team (see attachment: GF-sponsor-checklist.pdf). Happy to hop on a 20–30 minute call this week to align.

Best,
Emma Bates
Partnerships Lead — Greenfield Labs
emma@greenfieldlabs.com

Attachments:
- GF-sponsor-checklist.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Emma Bates <emma@greenfieldlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sponsorship inquiry — HackDay workshop & tier request

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear ask and the checklist.

Short answers up front:
- Trading the 30-min panel for expanded pre-event workshop promotion is possible. We can commit to a featured spot in two pre-event marketing emails and one social post from Redwood.
- We can reserve the 6x6 demo pod for the duration of HackDay.
- Workshop registrants will receive a discounted code (50% off) for day-of main sessions — we'll include that in the workshop confirmation email.

About the stage logo: we have three stage tiers (platinum, gold, silver). Platinum gets top-left 450px height placement, gold gets 300px, silver 220px. To get the 300px minimum you should qualify for the gold tier or a custom placement add-on.

I spoke with Marissa and Aditya and they recommend a custom "Gold + Workshop Promotion" bundle we can price at $38,000 (list gold is $45k). The bundle includes:
- Gold-level logo placement on stage backdrop
- Half-day workshop room with AV (projector + mic + 2 tables)
- 6x6 demo pod (end wall)
- Two featured spots in marketing emails + one Redwood social post
- 25 discounted conference passes for workshop attendees

I've attached a short proposal for that bundle (RDW-sponsor-bundle-proposal.pdf) and the venue floorplan showing the demo pod placement (floorplan_v3.pdf). Can you confirm:
1) Is $38k within your budget if we accept the slot trade?
2) Will your legal team accept a two-week DocuSign turnaround for contract and PO?

If yes, I'll send a DocuSign invite with the redlined terms we discussed. Call oportunity: I'm free Thu 10–10:30am PT if you'd rather talk.

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Events Manager, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com

Attachments:
- RDW-sponsor-bundle-proposal.pdf (attachment stub)
- floorplan_v3.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Emma Bates <emma@greenfieldlabs.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Greenfield Labs Sponsorships <sponsorships@greenfieldlabs.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sponsorship inquiry — HackDay workshop & tier request

Sofia, Marissa (cc'd),

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the draft bundle. Two notes from marketing and legal after internal review:

Marketing: the 300px requirement is non-negotiable for our CMO because the workshop will be branded as a product-led demo push. Gold + workshop add-on at $38k is within reason if you can confirm the logo will be in the top-right quadrant (not occluded by AV rig). The floorplan looks fine but can you provide a mock-up of the stage asset with our logo so we can sign off?

Legal/Procurement: the procurement team redlined a couple of items in the contract — primarily around indemnity and data capture of attendee lists. I've attached our redlines (GF-Redwood-sponsor-redlines.docx). We generally prefer a 30-day PO window but can do 14 if pricing is locked.

If you can accept the redlines in principle and send a stage mock with logo placement by EOD Mon (13th), we'll prioritize internal sign-off. If not, we may need to revisit the panel swap.

Thanks — Emma

Attachments:
- GF-Redwood-sponsor-redlines.docx (attachment stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Bates <emma@greenfieldlabs.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sponsorship inquiry — HackDay workshop & tier request

Hi Emma — looping in Aditya from Events Ops to confirm AV clearances and stage mock.

Aditya — can you produce a stage asset mock with Greenfield Labs logo centered in the top-right quadrant at 300px height (PNG) and double-check that the AV rig won't occlude the upper corner? We also need confirmation that the 6x6 demo pod placement in floorplan_v3 won't disrupt foot traffic for workshops.

On the legal points: Sofia, I've reviewed the redlines. Two quick takeaways:
- Indemnity: we can accept Greenfield's suggested language with a capped liability clause aligned to event fees.
- Attendee lists: we typically provide opt-in lists only (GDPR-friendly). We can commit to providing the workshop registrant list excluding sensitive fields; full attendee export requires an enterprise add-on.

Next steps I propose:
1) Aditya sends stage mock + confirmation by Tue EOD (14th).
2) Sofia and I incorporate the agreed redlines into a DocuSign packet and send to Emma with a 14-day PO window.
3) Emma to send final go/no-go by Wed (15th) so we can lock production asset deadlines.

I'll produce the DocuSign link once Aditya confirms the mock.

Thanks — Marissa Cole
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments:
- (none)
